description: TripCanvas is an AI travel agent, trip planner, and travel itinerary builder inside ChatGPT. It turns your dates, destination, interests, constraints, preferred pace, and travel companions into a complete public trip website: a geographically coherent route, day-by-day itinerary, overnight bases, driving distances, road names, maps, places to see, and priority bookings in one shareable link for the whole group. Users connect a TripCanvas account through OAuth; one new website is included per UTC month, while reopening and sharing do not consume another allowance unit. When no allowance remains, the plugin shows the reset date and links only to an informational account-and-allowance page. It never displays prices or initiates a purchase inside ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Plan a 7-day Andalucía road trip and make a shareable website with maps, overnight stops, drive times, and a daily plan.
Create a relaxed 5-day family trip to Lisbon, choose where we sleep each night, and publish it as a shareable site.
Use what you know about my travel style to plan 10 days in Japan and publish the full trip as a shareable website.
